answer: Proof of Stake mechanisms require agents to bond tokens to participate in consensus, creating an ocean of capital that acts as a barrier to entry. If an attacker attempts to flood the network with fake identities, their influence reaches a nadir because the cost of acquiring sufficient stake becomes prohibitive. This economic pressure acts as a gale, sweeping away malicious nodes that lack the financial capital to maintain their influence, thereby ensuring the network remains secure and sybil-resistant.
